map.折射定律公式？: Formula for the Law of Refraction?
map.n₁sinθ₁=n₂sinθ₂，θ 为与法线夹角；光密介质中角更小（更靠法线）。: n₁sinθ₁=n₂sinθ₂, with θ measured from the normal; in the optically denser medium the angle is smaller (closer to the normal).
map.为什么池水看起来浅？: Why Does a Pool Look Shallower Than It Is?
map.水到空气折射使池底虚像上移，看起来的深度=真实/折射率，约 3/4 实际。: Refraction from water to air shifts the apparent image of the pool bottom upward, so the apparent depth equals the true depth divided by the refractive index, roughly three quarters of the actual depth.
